title: Start a Review in Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini
summary: Blee runs on MCP inside Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini—send an asset for compliance review without leaving your work, then track it in the platform.
body_markdown:
Most review still begins with a detour. You leave the doc, open a portal, upload the asset, fill in the fields, and wait. The work you were doing sits idle while you go somewhere else just to kick off the check.


We don't think you should have to leave your work to start a review. So Blee runs where the work already is.


Blee runs on MCP inside Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini. Send an asset for review from right where you're working, answer a few intake questions, and it's submitted. No new tab. No separate login. No context switch. The same submission, the same experience, wherever you happen to be working that day.


Once it's sent, the asset lands in the Blee platform and the review begins. You can watch it there, or you can keep working—everything is tracked from the moment you hit send. You keep working. Blee keeps reviewing.


Available now via MCP in Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini. And everywhere else you work, too.
